title: Go physics library preference
content: If a physics dependency is needed, use a purpose-built Go library.

title: Powerup randomness implementation
content: Use Go’s crypto/rand for powerup randomness.

title: Bidirectional constants synchronization
content: Constants synchronization must not use an owner flag. Push maps matching TOML sections to Go/GDS blocks; pull reverses the mapping from matching Go/GDS blocks to TOML sections.

title: Player-data runtime composition
content: A sibling source file beside main.go imports and instantiates the player-data package; main() invokes that setup through a simple function call.

title: Potential Codex Write MCP Server
content: A second MCP server should probably be used for Codex writing operations.

title: Respawn devtool semantics
content: The devtool retains force-respawn functionality, with the user-facing label “Respawn.”

title: Deployment Authorization Requirement
content: The deployment build will always require authorization and will not support single-player connections.
